SKECHERS WORLD CHAMPIONS CUP 
SUPPORTING SHRINERS CHILDREN

attr.content:
NO PURCHASE OR PAYMENT OF ANY KIND NECESSARY TO ENTER OR WIN. A PURCHASE OR TEXT MESSAGE WILL NOT INCREASE YOUR CHANCES OF WINNING. ODDS OF WINNING WILL DEPEND ON THE TOTAL NUMBER OF ELIGIBLE ENTRIES RECEIVED. VOID WHERE PROHIBITED BY LAW. ALL DISPUTES WILL BE RESOLVED SOLELY BY BINDING ARBITRATION AND ENTRANTS WAIVE THE ABILITY TO BRING CLAIMS IN A CLASS ACTION FORMAT.

ELIGIBILITY: The Ticket Giveaway Sweepstakes (the “Sweepstakes”) is open only to legal residents of the contiguous United States and D.C .(excluding Rhode Island) (the "Eligible Territory") who are twenty-one (21) years of age or older at the time of entry. Employees, officers, and directors, and their immediate family members (spouse, parent, child, sibling, and their respective spouses, regardless of where they reside) and members of the same household (whether or not related), of World Champions Cup, LLC ("WCC"), SKECHERS USA, Inc. (“SKECHERS”), Shriners Hospitals for Children dba Shriners Children’s (“Shriners”), PGA TOUR Enterprises, LLC (“TOUR”), Intersport, LLC (“Intersport”) and each of their respective parents, affiliated companies, subsidiaries, licensees, distributors, dealers, retailers, printers, advertising and promotion agencies, and any other entity associated with the Sweepstakes are not eligible to participate or win a prize (together WCC, SKECHERS, Shriners, Intersport and TOUR shall be referred to herein as the “Tournament Parties”). The Sweepstakes is subject to all applicable rules and regulations. Void outside the Eligible Territory and where prohibited or restricted by law, rule, or regulation.

HOW TO ENTER: The Sweepstakes entry period begins at 9:00 a.m. Pacific Time (“PT”) on November 17, 2025, and ends at 11:59 p.m. PT on November 24, 2025 (“Entry Period”). To enter (i) follow the @worldchampionscup Instagram profile, like the sweepstakes post and comment on the sweepstakes post; or (ii) visit https://forms.fanthreesixty.com/giveaway_form?mnemonic=intwcc and complete the embedded entry form.

Except for the Bonus Entry (defined below), no other method of entry will be accepted and there shall be an aggregate limit of two (2) entry per person/email address/household (1 standard entry and 1 Bonus Entry). Additional entries beyond the specified limit will be void.

By participating in the Sweepstakes, you hereby agree to and accept all of the terms and conditions listed herein, as well as all of the terms and conditions of WCC’s Privacy Policy , which may change from time to time in WCC’s sole discretion with or without notice to you.  Please read the Privacy Policy carefully to understand how WCC collects, uses and discloses information about consumers. 

Entrants must fully complete and submit all data requested to be eligible. Incomplete and/or inaccurate entries are void. Entrants to the Sweepstakes may be given the option to receive (a) commercial emails from WCC and/or (b) mobile text messages and updates from WCC. Eligibility to participate in the Sweepstakes is not dependent upon entrant’s consent to receive such emails and/or mobile text messages and updates and consenting to receive such emails and/or mobile text messages and updates will not impact any entrant’s chances of winning. Standard messaging rates apply to mobile text messages and updates. Check with your mobile service provider for more information.

BONUS ENTRIES: During the Entry Period, entrant may receive one (1) bonus entry (“Bonus Entry”) sharing the sweepstakes post on entrant’s Instagram story.

RANDOM DRAWING; ODDS: The potential winner of the Sweepstakes will be selected by random drawing on or around November 25, 2025 (“Drawing Date”), from among all eligible entries. Subject to verification of eligibility and compliance with the terms of these Official Rules, the potential winner will be declared the official winner of the Sweepstakes (the “Winner”). The decisions of WCC are final and binding on all matters relating to this Promotion. Odds of winning depend on the total number of eligible entries received.

PRIZE: One (1) Prize Will Be Awarded. The winner will receive two (2) Captains Club Tickets for Sunday at the SKECHERS World Champions Cup Supporting Shriners Children’s golf tournament taking place December 7, 2025 at Feather Sound Country Club in Clearwater, Florida (the “Prize”). ARV: $900.00

PRIZE CONDITIONS: All Prize details shall be determined in the sole and absolute discretion of WCC. Winners are fully responsible for any and all applicable federal, state, territory, and local taxes (including income and withholding taxes). All costs and expenses associated with Prize acceptance and use not specified herein as being provided including, but not limited to, lodging, transportation costs, meals, gratuities and other expenses incurred by accepting the Prize are the sole responsibility of the Winners. The Prize is non-transferable and non-assignable, with no cash redemptions except at WCC’s sole and absolute discretion. WCC reserves the right to substitute the Prize (or any portion thereof) with a prize of comparable or greater value at its sole and absolute discretion. The terms and conditions of the tickets awarded as part of the Prize will govern if the event is not held, due to weather conditions, an act of God, an act of terrorism, civil disturbance or any other reason. Winners and their guest(s) agree to comply with all applicable event and venue regulations in connection with the Prize including those found at https://worldchampionscup.com/ticket-terms-and-conditions/ . Prizes may not be resold or offered for resale or used for any commercial or promotional purpose whatsoever. Any such resale or commercial or promotional use may result in disqualification and Prize forfeiture, and may invalidate the license granted by the event ticket(s).

NOTIFICATION: The potential winners will be notified via the social platform from which the winner’s post was selected (in the sole discretion of WCC) provided at the time of entry (the "Prize Notification"). In the event that any potential winner does not respond to any such Prize Notification within twenty-four (24) hours of the date of issuance or declines the Prize for any reason, a disqualification will result, the Prize will be forfeited and, at WCC’s sole discretion and time permitting, alternate potential winners may be randomly selected from among all remaining eligible entries.

The potential winners may be required to submit their valid social security number and/or other identification to WCC and may be required to execute, and return an IRS Form 1099 and an Eligibility and Release of Liability Waiver and, unless prohibited by law, Publicity Waiver, within two (2) days of the date of issuance. Failure to submit any identification required by WCC or to return the required documents within the specified time period, noncompliance with these Official Rules or the return of the Prize (or any portion thereof) or Prize Notification as undeliverable may result in disqualification and Prize forfeiture and, at WCC’s sole discretion and time permitting, may cause alternate potential winners to be randomly selected from among all remaining eligible entries.

By entering this Sweepstakes, each entrant gives their express permission to be contacted by WCC by telephone, email and/or postal mail for Sweepstakes purposes. Entries generated by a script, macro, or other mechanical or automated means will be disqualified. In the event of dispute as to the identity or eligibility of any potential winner based on a mobile phone number, social media site handle, or email address, the winning entry will be declared made by the Authorized Account Holder of the mobile phone number, social media handle, or email address used or submitted at the time of entry, provided the potential winner is eligible according to these Official Rules. The “Authorized Account Holder” is the natural person to whom the applicable mobile service provider, ISP, social media site or other organization (such as a business or educational institution) has assigned the mobile phone number, social media handle, email address used to enter. In the event a winning account selected is a joint account, the prize will be awarded in the name of the first-named account holder provided they are eligible according to these Official Rules. Proof to WCC’s satisfaction of being the authorized account subscriber may be required by WCC.

ARBITRATION; CLASS ACTION WAIVER: As a condition of entering this Sweepstakes, each entrant agrees that (a) any and all disputes, claims, controversies, or causes of action arising out of or relating to this Sweepstakes or any prizes awarded (each, a "Claim") shall be (i) arbitrated on an individual basis only and shall not be consolidated or joined with or in any arbitration or other proceeding involving a Claim of any other party and (ii) settled by binding arbitration in Cook County, Illinois before a single arbitrator appointed by JAMS in accordance with its then governing rules and procedures, and judgment on the award rendered by the arbitrator may be entered by any court having jurisdiction thereof; and (b) under no circumstance will entrant be permitted to obtain awards for, and entrant hereby waives all rights to claim, punitive, incidental, consequential, or any other damages, other than for actual out-of-pocket expenses. These Official Rules shall be governed by and construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of Florida, U.S.A, applicable to contracts entered into and performed exclusively in that State.

WINNER LIST: For the winner's names, mail a request and a self-addressed stamped envelope to be received no later than ninety (90) days after the Drawing Date to: World Champions Cup, LLC, Attn: Legal and Business Affairs, 303 E. Wacker Drive, Suite 2200, Chicago, Illinois 60601.
